Designed for the hardcore Adventurer, the REVIT Dominator Gloves offer high levels of functionality in all weather conditions. REV'IT Spitfire Gloves

As aggressive as the name itself, the REV’IT! Spitfire Gloves are packing a lot of track-level heat in a sleek updated design. Engineered to coordinate with the REV’IT! Spitfire Race Suit as well as the Venom Race Suit, the Spitfire Gloves use the same aluminum dual comp sliders in the knuckle and wrist, and honeycomb TPUs at the heel of the palm.

External stitching and a tri-fleece liner make the Spitfire Gloves as all-day comfortable as you would expect from a REV’IT! Glove of this caliber. The 3-point double-cuff closure offers unparalleled adjustment and security. The REV’IT! Spitfire Gloves are the perfect track gloves for many riders, benefitting from the research and race DNA of the full-bore kangaroo leather Jerez Pro, but with a more accessible construction.

Protection Features:

Ergonomic Features:

  • Fit: race fit

REV'IT Stellar 2 Gloves

If you enjoy really carving up corners on the street or maybe are just getting into track riding, the REV’IT! Stellar 2 Gloves offer lightweight track protection in a flexible, streetable package.

Rather than the one piece guard covering the entire backhand found on the previous Stellar gloves, the Stellar 2 Gloves incorporate a more streamlined Tryonic knuckle and a separate Temperfoam Self-contouring foam that is not CE approved but still holds impact resistant properties, this product is used in areas where mobility is a must. backhand for better flexibility than their predecessors.

Other refinements in both protection and comfort include a shift from a hard protector at the outseam to patches of SuperFabric for flexible slide protection, and externally stitched fingers for maximum comfort, dexterity and feel on the controls.

Best of all, REV’IT! accomplished all this while shaving down the price from the previous Stellar Gloves. If you are looking for an aggressive street glove or lightweight track glove, you will be hard pressed to find a better value than the REV’IT! Stellar 2 Gloves.

Protection Features:

  • Outer Shell: drum dyed goatskin, SuperFabric, PU coated fabric
  • Lining: tricot liner
  • Protection: TPU ventilated hard-shell knuckle, TPU hard-shell palm slider, TPU finger knuckles, SuperFabric panel, PWR Shield knit, PWR yarn, Temperfoam at fingers, thumb, knuckle, back hand, palm slider and cuff

Ergonomic Features:

Protection Features:

  • Outer shell: goatskin drum dyed with WR finish, PWR|shell ripstop stretch, PWR|oxford, connect finger tip fabric, synthetic PU leather, flock PU
  • Insulation: Thinsulate G, high loft poly fur liner
  • Lining: tri-fleece liner
  • Waterproofing: Gore-Tex Gloves + Gore grip technology
  • Breathability: Gore-Tex Gloves + Gore grip technology
  • Composition:
    • outer shell: 55% goat leather, 33% polyamide, 7% polyester, 5% polyurethane

source_description_html:
The REV'IT Sand 4 Gloves are an expertly engineered summer glove that can take you anywhere. Designed for ventilation and protection, the REV'IT! Sand 4 Gloves breathe like a purely off-road glove while offering the levels of protection of a road-bound touring glove.  The Sand 4's begin with a goatskin palm that extends down the wrist and wraps the thumb and fourth fingers. Paired with the goatskin leather are abrasion-resistant stretch mesh fabrics and an integrated TPR knuckle protector. This prominent semi-rigid knuckle protector reduces impact forces against the back of the hand. The knuckle protector features an open cell structure to direct uninterrupted airflow onto the hands.

Further perforations on the outside of the glove and control side of the hand increase airflow. Additional TPR protectors on the fingers and thumbs and a TPR palm slider are ready for any unplanned gravity checks. The Sand 4 Gloves sport an oversized pull tab on the cuff for easy entry and are secured with a hook and loop wrist strap. Smart connect fingertips keep you connected while getting lost. 

Where you're going, you might not need roads. On or off the tarmac, the Sand 4 Gloves are a no-compromises choice for the adventure-bound rider. 

Protection Features:

  • Outer Shell: 3D air mesh | stretch | connect finger tip leather | goatskin | PWR|shell 500D stretch 
  • Lining: tricot lining
  • Composition: 68% Leather, 20% Polyester, 11% polyamide, 1% polyurethane
  • Protection: injected ventilated flex knuckle | Temperfoam® knuckle | PWR|shield at Palm | TPR injected finger knuckle protectors | TPR palm slider

  • Adjustability: adjustment tab at cuff
  • Ventilation: ventilation panels, ventilated TPR injected knuckles

source_description_html:
Get up to speed and hit the track with the Argon 3 one-piece suit - entry-level in price, but not in performance. With an aerodynamic, race-derived design and style for miles, it delivers everything you need to step up your game. Most importantly, it comes with a top-tier, class AAA safety rating.

Performance focus and protection
Lightweight, ergonomic design meets high-performance focus and top-tier protection, with an aggressive racing pre-shaping, the Argon 3 one piece balance performance with practicality: The best of race-ready performance - without going all out on spec or carrying a Grand Prix price tag.

Lightweight and agility-focused
Comfort is a key part of the Argon 3 one-piece suit’s appeal, thanks to accordion stretch panels at the lower back and above the knees, along with elasticated PWR|Shell stretch fabric that complements the durable, strategically ventilated buffalo leather. Clever details - like the sleek and thin, rubberized cuff design and calf expansion zippers - add a level of ease you didn’t know you needed. Additionally, the suit features lightweight and flexible BETAC® armor, with CE-level 2 protection at the elbows and knees, lighter agility-focused CE-level 1 armor at the shoulders, and SEESMART hip protection.

Thoroughly modern
Upgrading the Argon 3’s protection is simple, with integrated protector pockets ready to accommodate a CE-level 2 SEESOFT back protector and CE-level 1 SEESOFT divided chest protectors. And, staying true to its modern design, the suit incorporates all the necessary stretch for a true-to-size airbag-ready fit - setting you up for the most demanding sport riding on the road and giving you the confidence to clock your best laps on the track.

source_description_html:
Distinct race-ready style with a spec sheet to match - the Hyperspeed 3 one-piece is our top-of-the-range leather racing suit. Built with technology taken directly from our Grand Prix and Superbike racing efforts, it boasts a class-AAA safety rating and track-ready confidence woven into every detail of its construction.

Design, Performance, and Innovation
From dual-compound hard-shell armor at the shoulders and knees to replaceable knee and elbow sliders, every component of the Hyperspeed 3 one-piece comes straight from REV'IT!’s MotoGP racing technology catalog - the very same technology our professional athletes rely on while chasing victories on the world’s most demanding tracks. Even the race-ready, pre-shaped cut and panel design are directly influenced by what works best for the pros - now made to work for you. Pushing the boundaries of design, performance, and innovation, we’ve integrated PWR|Weave - TPU-infused yarn paneling - to add lightweight breathability and the bold, expressive style that defines the Hyperspeed lineup.

Built-in agility
Accordion stretch panels at the lower back, shoulder blades, and above the knees set the tone for the Hyperspeed 3 one-piece’s built-in agility. Additionally, PWR|Shell stretch fabric envelops your body from the shoulders down, past the waist, and around the back of the legs, ensuring unrestricted movement on the bike and into the turns.

Serious performance protection
Beneath its stylish and strategically ventilated design, the Hyperspeed 3 one-piece delivers serious performance protection. High-quality Monaco cowhide leather serves as the outer layer, while flexible BETAC® armor provides CE-level 2 protection at the elbows and knees, with lighter, more agility-focused CE-level 1 armor at the shoulders. SEESMART hip protection comes standard. For even more protection, built-in protector pockets allow for easy upgrades with a CE-level 2 SEESOFT back protector and CE-level 1 SEESOFT divided chest protectors. And, as expected from our top-spec racing suit, the Hyperspeed 3 one-piece is fully airbag-ready with a true-to-size construction.

source_description_html:
The same performance-focused design and construction as our race-ready leather one-piece suits, made to offer two-piece combi-suit practicality: that’s what our Argon 3 combi is for. Taking cues from our racing efforts in MotoGP and WorldSBK, the Argon 3 combi suit combines praticality with performance while still boasting a top-tier AAA safety rating.

Performance with added practicality
Aggressively styled with a sporty fit, the Argon 3 combi provides sporty street riders with all the kit to look the part and tap into the inherent confidence a leather race suit provides. At the same time, the two-piece construction simply adds practicality.

Perforated leather and breathable mesh
Having the ability to zip and unzip the top and bottom whenever you feel like it opens up a wide range of possibilities - all with the right performance elements, like the speed hump and the exact same extremity-guarding hard parts we provide our racing riders. And since performance riding requires ample cooling, we’ve made sure the entire combi suit is decked out with perforated leather panels and breathable mesh fabrics to let in cooling air.

Securely on your sporty way
To send you securely on your sporty way, safety is an integral part of the Argon 3 combi design. With our ventilated CE-level 2 SEEFLEX armor at the shoulders, elbows, and knees, you’re well-equipped with standard protection. With pockets ready to accept an optional CE-level 2 SEESOFT back protector and CE-level 1 SEESOFT chest protection upgrades, and a true-to-size airbag-ready design, you get everything you need to further quench your sporty riding thirst - while keeping style and safety in check.

source_description_html:
Zip into the Control one piece and get ready to take on your next track session with confidence. A byproduct of our learnings through our MotoGP riders and their suits, we bring you an airbag-prepared suit that excels in design and safety.

What meets the eyes
If you know our Sport lineup of products, you’ll know the emphasis on graphics is paramount. However, we’ve taken a step in a different direction here. We wanted to create a track-ready one-piece that uses ergonomic flowing graphics that play with scale. What does that mean? From a distance, the product shows a gradient type of effect, emphasising the depth and layers, yet up close, the graphics show flowing diamond shapes merging into fast lines to show speed. This is best illustrated with the print on backside of sleeve that follows the flow of the body. We’ve also been exploring brining a synthetic leather with a smoother texture into the mix to further emphasize the applications like the laser-cut perforation holes and the prints to appear even sharper than before.

Ready to race
When throwing down your fastest lap times, you want to feel confident that your safety is accounted for should something happen. We take care of that. The Control one-piece is prepared for Tech-Air™ airbag system. Everything you see in terms of the construction and the placement of the stretch is to make sure the expansion of the airbag is correct, it’s not just to make you look good. Furthermore, new, slimmer elbow sliders and elasticated comfort cuffs, along with pockets for optional back and divided chest protectors (should you not opt for the airbag option) are already incorporated. These, and a host of other safety features (BETAC® elbow, knee, and shoulder protectors), safety seams, and much more all equate to a CE Class AAA certification.

source_description_html:
Meet the pinnacle product of the Quantum family: the Quantum 3 one-piece suit. It leads the pack in terms of design language, safety features, and overall sport style.

Evolution of graphics
The Quantum series is renowned for its bold, in-your-face, immediately recognizable graphics. This generation stays true to its roots. The Quantum 3 one-piece innovates through its design by drawing inspiration from 80s/90s digital screen visuals, think computer glitch graphics, and by exploring diverse color styles and combinations across different variants. It also features the most outspoken colors available, setting it apart within the Quantum lineage.

Within its DNA
As a AAA-rated suit, the Quantum 3 one-piece leads the way in terms of materialization, fit, and features. Created with a symbiotic mix of Monaco performance cowhide, 3D air mesh, PWR|Shell stretch, neoprene (at the collar), and synthetic materials, these factors work together to enhance performance and comfort. Whether tucked in for a time attack on the track or going for a sporty road ride, the fitting shape is geared to move with the rider in every possible scenario.

Ready to race
The renewed outer armor (the hard parts) at the elbow, knee, and shoulder features a more aerodynamic appearance and comes as standard, along with internal Betac® protectors (at the elbows, knees, and shoulders), and SEESMART hip protectors. Increase the safety ante even further with the available SEESOFT back or divided chest protection, or with the Avertum Tech-Air® and Tech-Air® 5-compatible airbags (true to size).

source_description_html:
Emerging from the momentum created by the original iteration, the Beta 2 combi takes long-distance adventure sport gear to a whole new level.

The design
The Beta 2 combi features aggressively sportive panels complemented by a rich combination of materials, creating a visually striking mix. Dynamically printed shapes not only serve an aesthetic purpose but also underscore the engineering behind the garment, contributing depth to its visual appeal. Reflective details enhance visibility, prioritizing safety during low-light conditions. The Beta 2 combi is also airbag prepared, one size up.

The foundation
Its construction is rooted in materials such as perforated leather, 3D mesh for ventilation, and strategically placed stretch fabric panels (even more than before) for optimal flexibility for long-distance rides. The inclusion of neoprene on the inside collar ensures comfort throughout the journey. The oval-shaped perforations are dynamically laser-cut at the chest and upper back and not only add to the suit's aesthetic appeal but also provide an additional layer of airflow, improving upon comfort for riders pushing their limits.

Functionality and style
Practicality meets style with strategically placed storage pockets at the waist, offering a convenient solution to keep essentials within reach during travels. The color variants draw inspiration from popular adventure sport motorcycles, so riders have no problems with matching their bikes if so desired. Also included are the newly developed shoulder parts, which not only add to comfort but also enhance the jacket's aerodynamic aesthetic.

source_description_html:
The Stratum (which means layers of rock) GTX motorcycle pants are our next-generation adventure motorcycle pants that consist of two outer shells. The base outer shell is an air mesh with built-in protectors, and on top of that, a GORE-TEX® waterproof outer shell can be used during rides in cold or wet weather. This new two-layer system provides maximum versatility and comfort in any season or any weather conditions.

During rides in Spring and Summer or in warmer temperatures the in-boot, air mesh motorcycle pants will keep you both cool and comfortable. The AA CE-certified air mesh motorcycle pants are equipped with our CE-level 2 SEEFLEX protectors that are adjustable and are found at the knees. Also included are our CE-Level 1 SEESMART hip protectors. Soft leather panels on the lower inside legs provide extra grip when standing on the motorcycle.

When the weather takes a turn for the worse, or for rides in colder and wet climates, the waterproof 3L GTX laminated shell can be added on top of the base air mesh motorcycle pants ensuring maximum waterproofing and weather protection. This waterproof shell is a class B CE-certified and combined with the AA rated air mesh layer, offering the highest level of protection in our adventure collection. The big side zippers make it very easy to put on the motorcycle pants without having to take your boots off. Ventilation zippers on the inside of the upper legs will provide airflow to your body when the sun is shining bright in the sky.

Take on any weather with the Stratum GTX motorcycle pants.

source_description_html:
Adventure. Athleticism. Sport. Just three adjectives that go hand-in-hand with the Potential GTX pants. A perfect complement to the Potential GTX jacket created to push the boundaries of design, waterproofing, and the need for speed.

Waterproofing solution
We included a GORE-TEX® Z-liner construction in the Potential GTX pants. The GORE-TEX® membrane is bonded to a lightweight fabric which means it is then freely suspended between the outer fabric and the lining. This had a twofold outcome for us. The first being that since the waterproofing isn’t laminated to the polyester ripstop and stretch twill outer shell, we were able to play around with the outer shell materials, to create something unique. The second being a cleaner-finished product. Since the membrane is floating, the stitches are hidden making the Potential GTX’s outsides what they are. An included detachable thermal liner enhances the Potential GTX pants’ overall seasonal versatility.

An athletic stance
Even when you’re not wearing the Potential GTX pants, you know they ooze sport. Their pre-shaped silhouette with a slim fit is meant to feel like a second skin. But with the added stretch (also at the waistband), making them more comfortable to ride in and giving wears the flexibility needed when carving corners or walking around.

source_description_html:
The Sand series is an icon in the REV'IT! lineup, embodying a distinctive style that has, over the years, defined travel within the motorcycle industry. That legacy continues with the Sand 5 H2O pants.

Designed for the Future
The Sand 5 H2O pants take on a slightly more speed-driven character compared to the outgoing Sand 4. As adventure bikes become more sportive and dynamic, the Sand 5 H2O pants reflect this industry shift. Through this new design, we were able to include drop-down ventilation panels on both front thighs and calf adjustable straps. Higher quality materials are also used to ensure the Sand 5 H2O pants carry you through whatever adventure you embark on.

The Over and Under Concept
We’ve taken our know-how of the proven over and under waterproof liner concept and applied it to our Sand 5 H2O pants. Wear the detachable liner over or under your protective, CE-certified layer according to your personalized preference for keeping the rain away—and keeping you dry. The waterproof liner, made of a resilient 3L hydratex material, has reinforcements at the seat and inside of the knees for long-term durability. Furthermore, to accommodate the over-under construction, the waistband of the main trousers—aka the protection layer—comes with a belt buckle and a stretch insert strategically positioned at the center front of the pant for improved comfort when sitting. The RWL (removable waterproof layer) is equipped with a snap with two-position adjustment. A detachable thermal liner is also included to up the ante on warmth and comfort on cold, rainy days.

This product contains recycled polyester:

source_description_html:
Adventure is about embracing the unknown, and to do that, versatility is key. Enter the third-generation Offtrack 3 H2O pants - true all-season all-rounders. Designed with a lightweight three-layer construction, they feature a technical outer shell, a detachable thermal layer, and waterproof hydratex rain pants with over-and-under functionality.

Tailored to your needs
Switch between the three layers and adjust your setup as needed. The durable softshell and ripstop outer shell, combined with ventilation panels at the thighs, provides built-in climate control - ensuring you stay cool when your ride heats up and comfortable in high-temperature adventures.

Safety assured
No matter how you layer up for your ride, you can rest assured that the Offtrack 3 H2O pants keep you protected. They come equipped with ventilated CE-level 2 SEEFLEX knee protection and thin yet flexible CE-level 1 SEESMART hip armor for optimal safety.

Comfortably in control
Wherever your adventure takes you, the Offtrack 3 H2O pants are designed to adapt. Featuring ample hook-and-loop adjustment, they provide the flexibility to be worn over boots without feeling bulky - while also allowing for a snug fit when tucked into off-road boots. Additional thoughtful design elements include a built-in buckled waistband adjustment - for maintained wearing comfort with the rain layer worn on top - and both short and long connection zippers to attach the pants securely to your jacket - keeping you comfortably in control.

description: Meet the Quantum 3, a perforated leather jacket designed for sport riders who take on the streets. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Meet the Quantum 3, a perforated leather jacket designed for sport riders who take on the streets.

Racing DNA
As part of a lineage conceived with racing DNA, the Quantum 3 jacket is designed less for the track and more for the street. The absence of a speed hump and elbow sliders is an immediate indication of its street focus. However, sport elements remain at its core, including a tight, race fit, the immediately recognizable Quantum series computer-glitch inspired graphics, and hard shoulder parts. SEEFLEX armor is incorporated at the shoulders and elbows, and the SEESOFT back or divided chest protection is available if you want to enhance safety.

Ventilation and warmth
Perforated leather at the front, lower arms, and around the back allows riders to feel the breeze during warmer rides, while the detachable thermal bodywarmer provides extra comfort for cooler mornings or later-season rides.

Move with ease
Despite its figure-hugging design, the Quantum 3 jacket offers the right amount of stretch in all the right places, enabling fluid navigation through urban streets. Pair it with a chic pair of our motorcycle jeans or our leather Apex pants for a look that fits your riding aesthetic.

Engineering you’d expect from a fourth-generation motorcycle jacket, the Ignition 4 H20 takes multi-season performance to its peak. Urban-inspired, premium-grade materials deliver signature REV’IT! sporty looks with three-season comfort, while premium panel construction blends high-quality cowhide and tightly woven PWR|Shell mesh – natural materials and textiles combined for maximum abrasion resistance and airflow.

Versatile for varying weather
For unpredictable conditions ahead, layers make this jacket more versatile. Just zip in your choice of packable liner – thermal or hydratex or both – and you’re ready for the elements. Arrive cool and calm

Top it all with our award-winning SEEFLEX CE-Level 2 armor on the shoulders and elbows to make every trip cooler, calmer, and just that little bit safer.

source_description_html:
Based on the track-ready Control one-piece suit, the street-ready Control jacket uses top-tier materials – think Monaco performance cowhide, neoprene, and vegan leather – that trickle down from our learnings in the highest levels of racing so you can ride protected out on the roads.

Go with the flow
We wanted to create a sport street jacket that uses ergonomic flowing graphics that play with scale. What does that mean? From a distance, the product shows a gradient type of effect, emphasising the depth and layers, yet up close, the graphics show flowing diamond shapes merging into fast lines to show speed. This is best illustrated with the print on backside of sleeve that follows the flow of the body. We’ve also been exploring brining grainless cowhide into the mix to further emphasize the applications like the laser-cut perforation holes and the prints to appear even sharper than before.

Controlled elements
Making the Control jacket ready for multi-season use is the inclusion of the detachable body warmer. Keep it in on cooler mornings or take it out and let the laser-cut ventilation holes direct airflow to your body. On the safety side of things, on the exterior of the Control jacket you’ll find dual-comp shoulder parts with TPU, yet on the inside, SEEFLEX shoulder and elbow protection as well as the option to add the SEESOFT back protection or the SEESOFT divided chest protectors.

The Automate Jacket seamlessly integrates a rational design approach with creative vision, resulting in a high-performance garment that excels in both style and functionality for long-distance sportive riding.

The foundation
Created with a mix of materials, the combination of 3D mesh panels, perforated leather, and laser perforations maximizes airflow, providing excellent ventilation for warmer rides. When things cool down, its detachable body warmer helps to keep the chest at a comfortable temperature.

Sport flair
To make the Automate jacket immediately recognizable, we played with various shades of the same hue to create a shadow-type effect; for example, a bright red placed beside a darker red – across the chest. Furthermore, newly developed shoulder parts not only add to comfort but also enhance the jacket's aerodynamic aesthetic, aligning seamlessly with modern Adventure Sport motorcycles.

Sport fit. Comfortable feel.
A sport/tight fit sometimes can come at a cost. Not with the Automate jacket. Side stretch panels have been included along with stretch at the shoulders. Move freely regardless. Furthermore, hook-and-loop adjustments at the waist allow riders to personalize the jacket’s fit even more. And neoprene in the collar ensures a comfortable fit around the neck, contributing to an overall enhanced wearing experience.

It’s a daunting task when trying to improve upon the pinnacle motorcycle jacket of our adventure collection, but we made it happen. Go ahead, travel anywhere, anytime with the Dominator GTX motorcycle jacket. Your next adventure awaits.

source_description_html:
The Horizon 3 H2O motorcycle jacket brings you the functionality of a high-end waterproof touring motorcycle jacket at an affordable price. We've laminated our renowned hydratex|Lite membrane to the outer shell to create a 100% waterproof motorcycle jacket with little to no water pickup. For rides in colder temperatures, we equipped it with a detachable and separately wearable thermal liner. With the detachable thermal liner removed, you can easily open the front ventilation panels while riding. The two mesh panels on the chest and the two exhaust vents around back change your waterproof touring motorcycle jacket into a highly ventilated motorcycle jacket; making sure you stay comfortable while riding in higher temperatures.

The Horizon 3 H2O is equipped with our award winning SEEFLEX CE-level 2 protectors at the shoulders and elbows (adjustable), and is prepared for a safety upgrade via the SEESOFT CE-level 2 back protector insert and the CE-Level 1 chest protectors. Various adjustment tabs and straps will ensure a perfect fit to your body. To keep your essentials close, the Horizon 3 H2O comes with a variety of pockets including two waterproof stash pockets at the front and a big pocket on the back. To stay visible, we've placed a reflective logo on back of the motorcycle jacket, as well as in the reflective stripes and logos on the arms.

Affordable. Technical. Driven by the need to perform in various weather. That’s the Horizon 3 H2O motorcycle jacket.

Top-of-the-line racing tech in a dedicated, street-ready jacket - get up to speed with the Hyperspeed 3 Pro jacket. Technically the top half of our one-piece suit of the same name, this is a top-spec sports riding jacket. description: The Defender 3 GTX is designed for those who dream of exploring uncharted horizons and don't stop until they’ve fulfilled that dream. No matter what… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
The Defender 3 GTX is designed for those who dream of exploring uncharted horizons and don't stop until they’ve fulfilled that dream. No matter what weather types you might encounter while chasing that dream, the Defender Pro GTX will help keep you going thanks to the detachable waterproof liner with a 3L GORE-TEX® membrane. This waterproof motorcycle jacket is also equipped with a removable thermal liner for rides in colder weather. If you are looking for a motorcycle jacket with ample ventilation features, look no further because this motorcycle jacket has plenty of options to regulate the amount of airflow to your body.

Next to the VCS|Ventilation panels on the front and the multiple zippers on the arm and back, the motorcycle jacket also comes with a main front zipper that can be zipped open to reveal a mesh ventilation panel that directs a cool flow of air onto your body. With all the ventilation panels and zippers open, a lot of air will flow through the entire motorcycle jacket keeping you cool during rides in high temperatures. No matter what road you take - if there even is a road - this motorcycle jacket will keep you safe thanks to the SEEFLEX CE-level 2 protectors (at the shoulders and elbows) combined with the highly abrasion-resistant outer shell that is partly constructed with the rugged ripstop material.

To increase the abrasion resistance on the high impact areas of the outer shell, we added a protective multi-layer print to the elbow area as an additional layer of protection. It also comes prepared for the SEESOFT CE-level 2 back protector and our SEESOFT CE-level 1 divided chest protectors. If you want to upgrade even further, you can connect our Segur neck brace to the connection points on the jacket. There is plenty of space to store your essential belongings in the two front pockets, big rear pocket and two inner pockets. We also added a left sleeve pocket for easy access to payment cards or toll tickets without taking your gloves off. The front pockets can be closed with zippers to make sure your valuable possessions will stay put and will arrive together with you at your destination.

With our fully loaded versatile, do-it-all Defender 3 GTX jacket you can fulfil your dreams and explore the uncharted in any weather that nature throws your way.

source_description_html:
Designed to make serious adventure touring accessible, the Outback textile outfit has been a staple in our lineup for years - ridden around the world since its inception. Sticking with the tried-and-tested three-layer construction - with detachable thermals and hydratex waterproof liner - and now featuring upgraded chest ventilation, the fifth-generation Outback 5 H2O jacket takes its product proposition to the next level.

Speaking of security
Fit adjustment is paramount in any adventure-ready jacket, and the Outback 5 H2O is no exception. From the integrated waist-belt adjuster to buttoned and hook-and-loop tabs at the arms, plus drawcords along the hem, this jacket allows for free and comfortable movement on the bike while ensuring a secure fit. Speaking of security: top-tier CE-level 2 SEEFLEX protectors are integrated at both the shoulders and elbows, with the option to upgrade impact protection with a CE-level 2 SEESOFT back protector and divided SEESOFT (CE-level 1) chest protectors. Additional safety measures include strategically positioned reflective elements to ensure visibility in all conditions.

All the essentials
As expected from a jacket designed for adventures across all terrains and climates, the Outback 5 H2O is packed with storage options. From large, waterproof waist-mounted storage pockets at the front to two internal pockets - three if you count the additional pocket in the thermal liner - you’ll have plenty of space to keep all your essentials close at hand.

source_description_html:
Adventure is about embracing the unknown, and to do that, versatility is key. Enter the third-generation Offtrack 3 H2O jacket - a true all-season all-rounder. Built with a lightweight three-layer construction, it features a technical outer shell in fresh, rally-inspired colorways, a detachable thermal liner jacket, and an over-and-under hydratex waterproofing jacket.

Climate control built in
Switch between the three layers and tailor your jacket to your needs. With a durable PWR|Shell and PWR|Ripstop outer shell featuring large, easy-action ventilation panels at the front and back, you essentially have built-in climate control - allowing you to tackle high-temperature adventures while staying cool, even when the ride heats up.

Combination of three layers
Whatever combination of the three versatile layers you choose, you can rest assured that you're protected with ventilated, body-hugging CE-level 2 SEEFLEX impact protectors at the shoulders and elbows. The Offtrack 3 H2O is also prepared for additional protection, allowing for the upgrade of a CE-level 2 SEESOFT back protector and CE-level 1 divided chest protectors.

Adventure-ready design
As any adventure-ready jacket should, the Offtrack 3 H2O comes equipped with ample storage. If the waist-mounted stash pockets and the extra-large mesh lower-back pocket aren’t enough, the main jacket offers two additional inner pockets. Even the separately wearable thermal liner jacket has one, as does the hydratex over-and-under waterproofing liner.

source_description_html:
The adventures Pol Tarrés gets into tend to be extreme. In terms altitude, the cold, and certainly in the heat of the desert – racing the Africa Eco Race at the knife edge. Using Pol’s vast experience in going full-send as input, we’ve designed the fully ventilated Africa jacket. Puristic, straight forward, and ready to tackle the hottest of adventures.

Keep it pinned for longer
Refined yet rugged ballistic mesh meets crucial zones with laser-cut ventilation. Based on comments from Pol, up to 70% of the jacket is made to breathe in fresh air. All to allow for a rally-ready, breathable construction, as well as having super stretchy soft shell and hard-wearing ripstop fabric where it needs to be. A carefully assembled mix of materials that assures you’re kept cool when adventure heats up. To maintain focus and to keep it pinned for longer.

Purposeful ripstop and dark camo mesh
In terms of style, you’re looking at bright red, purposeful looking ripstop and a clear, dark camo print incorporated into the mesh panelling. Meanwhile the jacket is decked out in only the necessary pockets, with a pair above the hips and a chest pocket – with a goggle wipe – up front and one at the lower back. Plus, a practical inner jacket pocket to keep your personals in board.

Pol Tarrés style from every angle
On the technical side of things, the Africa jacket provides CE-level 1 SEESMART impact protection. Thin but effective, the elbow and shoulder guards offer comfort on any ride. Switching from on-road to off-road? Take them out and slip the jacket over your protection vest and head into adventure with an extremely breathable rally jacket that breathes Pol Tarrés style from every angle.

source_description_html:
The Sand series is an icon in the REV'IT! lineup, embodying a distinctive style that has, over the years, defined travel within the motorcycle industry. That legacy continues with the Sand 5 H2O jacket.

The Evolution
The latest iteration of the Sand series represents an evolution rather than a revolution. This change is marked by small tweaks and adjustments aimed at enhancing its overall performance. The Sand 5 jacket (as part of the Sand 5 outfit with matching pants) remains as relevant today as it was 15 years ago. In crafting the Sand 5, a delicate balance is struck, paying homage to the past while looking towards the future.

Shifting Styles
The Sand 5 H2O jacket takes on a slightly more sport-driven character compared to the Sand 4. As adventure bikes become more sport-centric and dynamic, the Sand 5 H2O reflects this industry shift. Matching the fast-paced nature of sport and the thirst for the uncharted, the Sand 5 H2O jacket fuses two genres into one. Furthermore, the jacket is hydration pack prepared in the lower back pocket (like with our Trail vest), with a cutout in the left corner to feed a water tube underneath the arm and up the front to be attached on the left side.

The Over and Under Concept
Like we previously introduced in one of our ADV jackets—the Offtrack 2 H2O—we’ve taken our know-how of the proven over and under waterproof liner concept and applied it to our Sand 5 H2O jacket. Wear the detachable hydratex 3L liner over or under your protective layer according to your personalized preference for keeping the rain away—and keeping you dry. Though we recommend wearing it over because of the high-performance characteristics of the membrane and its design-driven aesthetics. source_description_html:
Contemporary and clean by design, the Quadratic jacket offers a subtly sporty aesthetic in a highly ventilated, full-leather construction. A true sports riding jacket for everyday street rides and sunny days spent chasing corners.

Body-hugging fit without constraint
Perforation across the both the entire front, the back, and the upper arms meets durable yet flexible and lightly breathable stretch fabric throughout the Quadratic jacket’s design. This provides a body-hugging fit without restricting movement on the bike - easily adjusted for further comfort with tabs along the waist. Impact protection comes in the form of ventilated CE-level 2 SEEFLEX protectors at both shoulders and elbows, with the option to upgrade to an additional CE-level 2 SEESOFT back protector and CE-level 1 chest protectors.

Perfect match with jeans
Even though the Quadratic jacket features race-derived aerodynamic shoulder armor, it is very much a road-going garment. That means it’s equipped with pockets around the waist, another pocket behind the main zipper, and an overall slightly longer cut than our full-on sports riding jackets, like the Argon and Hyperspeed styles. The Quadratic jacket is also perfect for pairing with motorcycle jeans, whether using the jeans loops or the connection zipper to attach it to our riding jeans-specific Safeway belts with zip-on functionality. And with its detachable sleeveless thermal liner, you can extend your riding season when temperatures aren’t quite optimal - or just not yet.

If you’re looking for touring footwear that are durably waterproof, fully protective yet stylish and comfortable, it’s high time you meet our Risco H2O motorcycle boots. Made to offer peace of mind, knowing your feet will be comfortable, dry, and protected on your next tour in any type of weather.

Waterproof, protective, comfortable
Don’t take any risks and bank on the Risco H2O boots to be fully waterproof thanks to the breathable hydratex membrane, protective thanks to sturdy protection parts like our SEESOFT ankle disc and reinforcements at heel and toe keeping your feet shielded, and highly comfortable, too. The implementation of accordion stretch panels at both the front and back take care of that.

Uncompromised freedom
With extra freedom of movement, both riding and walking, the in-house developed, durable rubber sole provides ample grip on both the bike’s pegs and any other surface, too. Inside the boot the quality OrthoLite® insoles add to the notion of all-day comfort. Additionally, the zipper and a hook-and-loop closure flap that runs alongside the Risco H2O motorcycle boots allow you to easily slip into them or take them off – with waterproof bootie design keeping the waterproofing freedom.

Venture farther
Have no fear of adverse weather conditions and venture further than before on your next touring adventure because the Risco H2O motorcycle boots have you covered in comfort and in style.

source_description_html:
Any seasoned long-distance adventurer knows that your hands bear the brunt of whatever the weather throws at you. With the Lacus GTX you don't have to worry about the weather, not even sudden downpours or heavy storms. The GORE-TEX membrane keeps your hands and wrists dry by waterproofing both the natural and synthetic materials used in the construction of this glove. The main component is soft drum-dyed goatskin on the palm and back of the hand. Combining strength and flexibility with all-weather performance, the leather's water-repellent coating makes the Lacus GTX a great waterproof glove for all occasions. Plus, the fine Pittards® sheepskin at the palm and thumb contact points ensures firm grip when it counts. When you're on an adventure, your hands are the tools you use the most. The Lacus GTX offers protection for these elemental extremities in the form of a blend of hard shell and memory foam that wraps your hands and wrists. Should you hit the pavement, a TPU hard shell palm slider greatly reduces the risk of injury, while Temperfoam® along the fingers on the thumbs and palms protects your hands without restricting your movement. There's also thumb protection and therefore a thumbs up for adventurers.

  • Outer fabric made of drum-dyed, water-repellent goatskin, PU-coated fabric and PWR|Shell Stretch.
  • Stretch inserts on the fingers
  • Adjustment tab at the cuff

source_description_html:
Gore Grip technology prevents movement between the breathable, waterproof GORE-TEX membrane and the outer layer. In its construction, the Contrast GTX gloves combine perforated goatskin on the palm with PWR|Shell textile stretch on the backhand. And thanks to Pittards® sheepskin inserts on the palm and thumb, you can count on excellent grip, sensitivity and feel for optimal control in all conditions. Summer motorcycle touring often means long rides and with them the possibility of sudden rain showers. But they can't dampen your day when you're wearing the Contrast GTX. A number of technical features ensure that your hands stay comfortably dry and you can concentrate fully on the road. A pull tab on the wrist helps you take the glove off quickly. However, you won't need that if you need to operate a touchscreen. That's what the conductive fingertips on the index finger and thumb are for. The cuff of the Contrast GTX is made of a hard shell and foam, while Temperfoam® on the fingers, palms and thumbs gives you protection without restricting your freedom of movement. And when the going gets tough, a thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) palm glide and thumb guard minimize the risk of injury if your hands hit the ground. Plus, a hook-and-loop closure ensures a stable fit. This glove looks good, feels good, and makes it damn hard not to like.
